rule: User request: remove manual item/potion sales, retain merchant-approach valuable auto-sale, hero movement gains +1 for each level 2..10 and +0 thereafter.

movement.boots: Percentage of base 20, added independently of hero-level bonus.
movement.levelup: Grant only the cap delta to remaining points; no full refill.
movement.scope: The actual hero unit, not ordinary allies or temporary copied forms.

difference: Python reference has an unbounded level - 1 movement bonus. The level-10 cap is explicitly user-specified.
